label: Global header — logo above a full-width navy menu bar with 6 items; hamburger below 900px
semantic_signal: <header> containing a branding block (a.site-logo > img) and #block-mainnavigation with ul.menu; div.menu-icon is the mobile toggle
notes: Single-level on this page. Two items (Policyholders, Agents/Brokers) carry Drupal's menu-item--collapsed class, meaning they have children elsewhere in the site, but no submenu markup is rendered here — so sub-navigation cannot be modelled from the homepage alone. Nav bar background #00457C, links white Helvetica 12px bold, padding 0 40px. Logo 345x90.

label: Banner — gray login panel (heading + 2 stacked CTA buttons) at 25%, banner image at 75%
semantic_signal: Top-of-page section, one row, two cells: .content-top-right (col-md-3, the panel) and .cw-banner-image (col-md-9, the image). No repetition, no interactivity beyond the two links.
notes: AMBIGUOUS between hero and a media+CTA feature. It sits at the top of the page like a hero, but the copy is a login prompt rather than a headline, there is no h1 anywhere on the page, and the image is decorative (alt="home banner"). Panel background #B2B2B2, heading 13px bold white, buttons Georgia 16px white on #00457C, 142x37, stacked. Image 709x215. On mobile the panel stacks above the image. Note the source class is `content-top-right` but it renders on the LEFT.
resolution: RESOLVED (agent default, user declined to arbitrate): extend the boilerplate hero with a "panel" variant carrying an aside of CTA links beside the image. Keeps it in the hero slot and leaves room for a headline.

label: Brand colour bar — four 4px segments in blue / mauve / gold / lime directly under the banner
semantic_signal: A row of 4 equal columns, each holding an empty <span class="banner-bg bgN"> whose only styling is a background colour and 4px height. No text, no links.
notes: By the taxonomy this is a decorative divider and therefore NOT a component. Counter-argument: it is a recurring brand device, it is authored as page structure in the source, and reproducing it with default content is impossible since it is pure empty markup. Colours #80D5FF, #BD84BA, #E6B00F, #B9C21F; segment widths 222/237/237/224 (roughly 25% each).
resolution: RESOLVED (agent default): NOT a block. Rendered as a decorative 4-stop gradient rule on the hero section, so authors get no empty block to misuse.

label: Footer — Disclosures / Privacy Policy links on the left, copyright line
semantic_signal: <footer> with p.links (2 anchors separated by a pipe) and p.copy
notes: Very small. Links 11px #00447C, copyright 11px #999. The Privacy Policy link points off-domain to gafg.widen.net. Sits in the page's own footer region, so in EDS it belongs in the /footer document.
